title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Every kid's highlight
hook: Could you name one highlight for every player this season?
intro: Some kids had obvious big moments. Others did not.
statement: Every kid deserves to hear their best moment.
q1: Do you share one highlight for each player —
q2: or celebrate the team as a whole?
q3: What was the quietest player's best moment?
t1: Every team is different. But kids remember the season
t2: when they hear what they did well.
cta: Coaches — how do you close the season?
ctaLines: A highlight each. A team award. A slideshow.
ctaPrompt: Share your end-of-season habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Could you name one highlight for every player this season?
The season is ending. Some kids had obvious big moments. Others did not.
Every kid deserves to hear their best moment.
A highlight for each player or a team celebration. There is no single right way.
How do you close the season? Share your habit in the comments.
